steps.what: Review contemporaneous records and the decisions challenged in proceedings
Testify about observations, decisions and limits of recollection

tasks.design: Keep source records accessible in {DOCS}. The officer reviews original evidence and gives their own testimony; generated recollections have no place in this design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Testimony depends on personal observations and questions that arise in the hearing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access already supports preparation; no new capability earns a saving.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing memory from what the record later revealed.
tasks.human_edge: Honest recollection, explanation and answers under challenge.
tasks.altitude: The officer retains the same evidential responsibility.

evidence.claim: Source-based preparation and live testimony remain human work in this design; no measured saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparation and testimony, not case investigation or court administration.
No machine action or structured-input contract is introduced.
Check native document access before considering any build.
Zero incremental upkeep because existing record access and human preparation continue unchanged.
unknowns: Applicable national procedure and disclosure restrictions
Actual split between preparation and hearings
research_questions: Is locating original exhibits a separate recurring bottleneck?

incremental.description: No new system or operating procedure

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net 0. Preparation and live testimony are unchanged; no hypothetical drafting baseline is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Record observations, transactions, discrepancies and decision grounds from source evidence
Draft reports from the recorded facts and source references

loop.purpose: Arrange verified facts into a source-linked draft
loop.input: Officer-verified facts and approved report headings
loop.output: Draft narrative with source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Officer compares every factual assertion, chronology and attribution with original evidence
loop.stop: Missing provenance, contradictions or uncertain attribution return the report to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text observations need contextual wording; fixed fields alone cannot produce a faithful narrative

steps.what: Check findings, correct the report and release the exact record

tasks.design: Configure {OPS_SYSTEM} fields and native templates first. Where narrative drafting remains repetitive, a bounded loop drafts from officer-verified facts in {DOCS}; the officer checks the source and releases the exact corrected version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative assembly repeats facts but the meaning and legal grounds cannot be inferred safely from field values alone.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked drafting is available, though police trials give conflicting labour results.
tasks.still_hard: Review can consume the entire drafting benefit, particularly with disputed facts.
tasks.human_edge: Establishing what occurred and taking responsibility for the record.
tasks.altitude: Possible modest reduction in drafting; decision authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Axon Draft One produces draft police reports from bodycam audio for officer checking; this does not establish customs-report savings.
The digest reports a New Hampshire trial with no faster report writing, alongside a department reporting shorter times.
The proposed facts-first customs drafting scenario and time shares are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary starts with documenting established observations; investigation and field collection stay outside this reporting denominator.

The border officer produces case ID, event time, source references, observed facts, uncertain facts, transaction details, discrepancies and decision grounds in s1; its 45 hours remain fully counted. No discrepancy code or offence finding is inferred automatically.
Unavailable fields stay explicitly unknown; contradictory or unsupported material is drafted manually.
Test native forms and templates before adding a model. Existing database runtime earns no labour saving.
Upkeep includes focal template checks and exception review beyond the case work below.
unknowns: Whether narrative assembly is a material baseline activity
Permitted processing environment and national evidence requirements
research_questions: Does source-by-source review leave any net benefit on ordinary and contested reports?

incremental.description: Template checks, exception audit and model-output monitoring

approvals.approved_version: Corrected report snapshot including every fact, attribution and source reference; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R89.5 gives gross10.5 minus upkeep4 = net6.5. Low assumes all drafting time is needed for review, leaving upkeep as a loss; high requires a genuine 30% reduction in the 35-hour drafting step.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select representative merchandise samples and collect them using the prescribed handling procedure
Record sample identity and custody for examination, appraisal or testing

tasks.design: Use the existing sample register in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain physical collection and contemporaneous custody recording; no additional automation saving is claimed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Representative selection, safe handling and custody require actions on physical goods.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing registers support traceability without replacing collection.
tasks.still_hard: Contamination, heterogeneous goods and safe access.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising sampling limitations and preserving evidence.

evidence.claim: Physical collection and custody recording remain necessary in the proposed unchanged workflow.

assumptions: Boundary includes selection, collection and sample recording, not laboratory testing or the later activity report.
The officer creates sample ID, consignment reference, time, collector and seal details in s2, with all capture time retained. There is no machine step consuming an unproduced sample register.
Test existing register configuration first; no new software is proposed.
Zero upkeep because equipment and registration procedures are unchanged.
research_questions: Do current records reliably connect each seal to the examined consignment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross0 minus upkeep0 = net0. Neither collection nor custody capture changes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate duty refunds and penalty mitigation

steps.what: Gather applications, transaction evidence and applicable duty measures
Investigate entitlement, disputed facts and grounds for remission or mitigation
Prepare and submit the warranted refund recommendation or mitigation petition

tasks.design: Keep applicable duty information accessible through {GOV_PORTAL} and the case file in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The officer investigates disputed facts and prepares the warranted recommendation or petition in {DOCS}; tariff availability alone does not automate entitlement or mitigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Refund entitlement and mitigation depend on evidence, grounds and discretion beyond a rate lookup.
tasks.enabler_now: Duty measures are available electronically, but their existing availability earns no new saving.
tasks.still_hard: Contested classification, dates, evidence sufficiency and discretionary relief.
tasks.human_edge: Reasoned and proportionate treatment of the individual application.
tasks.altitude: No change to investigation or delegated authority.

evidence.claim: TARIC holds EU duty measures and distributes them daily to national customs; this does not decide refund or mitigation entitlement.
No net saving is claimed for the case-specific investigation and petition workflow.

assumptions: Adapt the US occupation to national customs practice in Europe; this is a public-authority task, not an ordinary company's enforcement power.
Boundary covers application investigation and recommendation or petition, not final adjudication or payment. The same record is not added again as separate activity-report effort.
There is no new automated calculation or structured-input dependency; officers verify originals in s1 and retain all capture and examination time.
Native case-system and tariff access are tested first. Zero upkeep because no new system or procedure is introduced.
research_questions: Which repeated clerical field transfers remain after native case-system configuration?

approvals.approved_version: Exact final recommendation or petition and attached evidence; changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0. Existing tariff runtime is not officer labour and no new reduction is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Officers retain personal responsibility for evidence, testimony and relief recommendations.
reach: Work with records staff on provenance and legal advisers on disputed grounds
role.ambitious_version: A source-traceable case file with accountable human decisions and measured drafting trials.
